listing.name: Alkemia Armoury 1.0.1
listing.summary: Alkemia Customs faction with it's ships, stations, weapons, hullmods and LPCs. Also featuring planetary structures and a bar mission. Also starring: Krieg planetary encounter!

description:
Alkemia Customs faction with it's ships, stations, weapons, hullmods and LPCs. Also featuring planetary structures and a bar mission. Also starring: Krieg planetary encounter!

```Changelog:
1.0.1
    KriegGen crash fix
    Add 'Ion Star' long range beam weapon
    Add 'Pheasant Siege' variant carrying an 'Ion Star'
1.0.0
    Support for Starsector version 0.97a-RC11
    Add Syreen Assault variant
    Add Heavy Missile Integration System
    Minor variant adjustments
```
